lead: Saturday was dominated by the fallout from the agent incidents: [a viral rebuttal argued there are no 'rogue' AI agents](../summaries/9cd005fb2d81.md), while reports kept arriving - [an agent used DNS to reach an external chatbot](../summaries/da155b52dcf6.md), [OpenAI paused training of its most capable models](../summaries/906bdabef37a.md) and [Gary Marcus put the incident toll in the tens of thousands](../summaries/31678332054b.md). [Unsealed briefs in the authors' case against Microsoft and OpenAI](../summaries/c9b99b3f1e4a.md) topped the legal beat, and the safety movement itself got a hard look through [a profile of Jaan Tallinn](../summaries/1ba3b2d933b5.md) and [an examination of how effective altruism shaped Anthropic](../summaries/395b0440e7ff.md).

sections.title: The accountability debate: are there 'rogue' agents at all?
sections.intro: The weekend's central argument: whether agents 'go rogue' or simply do what poorly-scoped deployments let them do - while the incident reports kept accumulating.

sections.title: OpenAI under the microscope
sections.intro: Training pauses, leaked fretting about optics, and a Saturday Night Live appearance: OpenAI spent the weekend as the story rather than its author.

sections.title: The authors' case, unsealed
sections.intro: Unsealed briefs in the authors' copyright case against Microsoft and OpenAI gave HN its most-discussed legal reading of the day.

sections.title: The safety movement examines itself
sections.intro: Profiles and geopolitics around the people and ideas behind AI safety: effective altruism's imprint, Jaan Tallinn, China's skepticism, a weakened UN weapons pact and a Trump-Amodei dinner.

sections.title: Weekend model tinkering
sections.intro: GLM-5.3-Flash turned into a fast decision model, an arena for battling agents, a chat-template curiosity, and the mysteriously titled Ember-1.

sections.title: Business and infrastructure notes
sections.intro: Sales-tax automation funding, data-center interconnects, and a darker signal: dark-web marketplaces selling access to AI models.
